## Services

- [SEO](https://vikramaa.com/services/seo/): Technical SEO audits, on-page optimisation, keyword research and mapping, schema markup, content strategy, off-page and link acquisition.
- [Performance Marketing](https://vikramaa.com/services/performance-marketing/): Google Ads and Meta Ads management, campaign architecture, audience research, creative testing, conversion tracking, optimisation against cost per qualified lead.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://vikramaa.com/services/social-media-marketing/): Social audits, platform strategy, content mix design, creative production, posting cadence, analytics-led optimisation.
- [Content Marketing](https://vikramaa.com/services/content-marketing/): Audience research, brand storyline and messaging, editorial planning, long-form production, distribution.
- [Lead Generation](https://vikramaa.com/services/lead-generation/): Offer design, channel selection, funnel build, lead scoring, CRM handover, nurture sequences.
- [Marketing & Sales Team Training](https://vikramaa.com/services/marketing-sales-training/): Skills assessment, custom curriculum, hands-on workshops on live accounts, sales enablement, playbooks and SOPs.

## How engagements work

1. Audit — review of site, analytics, ad accounts, content and the marketing-to-sales handover before any spend is recommended.
2. Strategy — a written plan naming the channels, audience, content, budget and the single metric being held to.
3. Execute — campaigns built, pages optimised, content shipped, either directly or by directing the in-house team.
4. Optimise — monthly review against the agreed metric; underperforming channels are cut rather than defended.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Pricing is quoted per engagement rather than published; ad spend is not billed as a percentage.
- No guaranteed rankings or guaranteed lead volumes are offered.
- Both execution engagements and team training engagements are available; training is a substantial part of the practice.
